text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector introducing the restricted mission clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the new assertion to the prior argument before the negation appears. Its value is not filler: the mission claim enters as connected correction, and the fused opening with the following negator lets continuity and denial arrive in one onset. The slow opening cadence delays the positive statement until the restriction resolves, so the universal commission is heard as part of an ongoing polemical turn.

topics.headline: connected restriction launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the mission claim as a connected correction inside the surrounding argument, not as an isolated slogan.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction introduces the negated restricted verbal clause and keeps it attached to prior discourse.

topics.headline: fused onset and suspended cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that linkage and negation arrive together before the positive mission profile is disclosed.
topics.reason: The single-letter connector is prefixed to the negator, and the sound row supports a delayed opening cadence.

words.gloss_range: negator in a restriction frame that denies alternatives while preserving the specified mission
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins as negation over the sending verb, but the later exception particle turns that negation into restriction. The reader should not hear denial of sending; the construction excludes other accounts so that total human address and the paired roles become the only preserved mission profile. Its long opening sound holds the clause in suspension until the exception supplies the positive content.

topics.headline: negation resolved by exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the grammar denies alternative mission accounts, not the fact of sending.
topics.reason: The negative particle scopes over the sending verb until the exception particle completes the restriction.

topics.headline: suspended negative field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause wait for the exception before the preserved content appears.
topics.reason: The critical rows connect the initial negator and written lengthening with delayed resolution at the exception.

words.gloss_range: completed commissioned sending of the singular addressee, expanded by audience and role complements
words.root_gloss_range: dispatch, release, sending, messenger-bearing, and communication; here narrowed to deliberate Form IV commissioning
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ}} ({{tr:arsalnāka}}) presents the commission as already enacted: a first-person plural sender causes the singular addressee to be sent. The attached object suffix keeps the messenger as the object of the verb while the totality term, the people phrase, and the two role nouns define the mission's mode, audience, and functions. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) field keeps movement and entrusted communication together, but Form IV and the restriction frame narrow that field to authorized dispatch, not self-release. The word also carries the prior dispute into divine commission: after the partner-challenge of 34:27, the speaker now declares a universal sending, with 21:107 and 34:16 providing contrastive sending echoes. A liquid-and-nasal sound thread also ties the commission to the people phrase and final knowledge-failure, so the ayah's arc is heard as well as parsed.

topics.headline: completed commissioned addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a completed divine commission of the singular addressee before any audience or role term is named.
topics.reason: The verb is Form IV perfect with first-person plural subject marking and a second masculine singular object suffix.

topics.headline: sending expanded by audience and roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb opens a structured mission event with object, recipient field, and role-states.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the clitic object, recipient preposition, totality word, and role accusatives to the sending clause.

topics.headline: dispatch and message, not self-release
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the movement-and-message pressure of the root while seeing that local Form IV selects deliberate commissioning.
topics.reason: The broader release field is valid background, but Form IV agency and the object suffix narrow the active sense to commissioned dispatch.

topics.headline: mission formula and sending echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this sending inside a wider mission formula while seeing this ayah's local addition of universal scope and paired roles.
topics.reason: Critical rows cite 21:107, 34:16, and the sending plus herald-warning pairing as formulaic or contrastive evidence.

topics.headline: from partner challenge to commission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior dispute over partners give way to direct divine commissioning of the messenger.
topics.reason: Boundary rows tie the end of 34:27 to the first-person commissioning declaration in 34:28.

topics.headline: sound thread across commission and reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears commission, people, and knowledge-failure bound by recurring liquid and nasal sounds.
topics.reason: The sound row identifies a local phonetic thread across the ayah's arc.

words.gloss_range: exception particle converting negation into exclusive mission definition
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge where negation becomes preserved content. Its scope reaches beyond the next word to the whole post-exception mission chain: totality, human audience, heralding, and warning. Because it stands immediately before the totality term, comprehensive scope becomes the first surviving content after excluded alternatives fall away. The compact independent particle carries the full structural load of changing denial into mission definition.

topics.headline: exception governs full mission profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the exception preserve the whole mission chain, not only the immediately following totality word.
topics.reason: The particle completes the restriction frame over the sending clause and the post-exception complements.

topics.headline: turn from denial to content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that comprehensive scope is the first positive content after alternatives are excluded.
topics.reason: The exception particle sits immediately before the totality term and opens the content beat.

topics.headline: small particle with large structural load
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a compact particle carrying the clause's decisive shift from negation to definition.
topics.reason: The form is a short independent exception particle completing a broad restrictive structure.

words.gloss_range: accusative totalizing state or adverbial mode of the sending
words.root_gloss_range: holding back, palm, enclosing, gathering, and all-together restraint; here narrowed to total inclusion rather than sufficiency
words.prose: {{ar:كَآفَّةًۭ}} ({{tr:kāffatan}}) makes totality the first item heard after the exception. Its accusative form works as a state or adverbial mode, so comprehensiveness belongs to how the messenger is sent rather than becoming a separate object. The {{ar:ك ف ف}} ({{tr:k-f-f}}) evidence is narrowed away from sufficiency and toward a holding-together image: no human segment is left outside the address. Its placement before the people phrase and its contrast with the later majority term make the ayah's scale irony visible: all are addressed, while most do not know. The long vowel and doubled consonant give the totality word extra visible and audible weight before the audience is named.

topics.headline: totality as sending mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees totality as a case-marked mode of the mission, not a detachable object.
topics.reason: The word is accusative and strongly licensed as a circumstantial or adverbial state under the restricted sending.

topics.headline: held-together inclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a holding-together image behind universality while the local sense remains total inclusion, not sufficiency.
topics.reason: The corrected root is k-f-f; the k-f-y sufficiency path is blocked by alignment and grammar, while restraint/gathering supports total inclusion.

topics.headline: first preserved scope against majority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's scale architecture: total address first, majority ignorance later.
topics.reason: Critical rows connect post-exception placement, pre-audience order, and the contrast with the later majority term.

topics.headline: heavy totality word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees extra weight on the totality term before the audience is named.
topics.reason: Rows identify madd, shaddah, and doubled consonantal pressure in the totality word.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition binding the universal scope to its human recipient field
words.prose: {{ar:لِّ}} ({{tr:li}}) anchors the total scope in recipients. After the totality term, the preposition keeps universality from remaining abstract: the mission is directed to, for, and assigned toward the human public. Its fusion with the following noun makes the relation hard to detach from the audience field before the herald and warning roles arrive.

topics.headline: recipient relation fixed before roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the human public fixed as the mission's directed recipient field before heralding and warning are named.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition governs the people noun as the recipient scope of the sending.

topics.headline: relation compressed into audience phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that relation marker and audience are fused tightly enough that the people phrase cannot be read as loose scenery.
topics.reason: The preposition, article contact, and recited lām-to-lām fusion support tight governance.

words.gloss_range: first people noun as definite collective recipient of the universal mission
words.root_gloss_range: human sociality, familiarity, perception, and the contested forgetfulness association; here narrowed to public humanity as addressed collective
words.prose: {{ar:لنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:l-nāsi}}) names the human public as the recipient field of the sending. The definite collective form fits the totality term because it gathers humanity as one addressed public rather than separate groups. The {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) pressure of social recognizability survives as a narrowed background: the audience is the familiar human world capable of recognition, which sharpens the later turn when the same public reappears under majority non-knowledge. The repetition also prepares the role shift from recipient to assessed population. The wider echo field matters too: 114:1 places the same human class under divine lordship, while 34:36 repeats the people-and-knowledge diagnosis within Saba.

topics.headline: definite collective audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees humanity as a known public whole receiving the mission, not as an indefinite or segmented group.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, collective, and governed by the recipient preposition attached to the sending verb.

topics.headline: social recognition under address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the social-recognition pressure of the human noun while local grammar keeps the sense at public humanity.
topics.reason: The derivational and image evidence colors the audience as socially recognizable, but the local construction selects the collective people noun.

topics.headline: same public moves between roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader anticipates that the same noun will return as assessed population, making the contrast internal to one public.
topics.reason: Critical rows trace the repeated people noun from recipient after the preposition to genitive complement after the majority term.

topics.headline: human-public echo field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places the people noun in a wider and same-surah field of public address and public misrecognition.
topics.reason: Rows cite 114:1 and the same-surah recurrence at 34:36 as echo evidence.

words.gloss_range: accusative herald role installed as part of the sending
words.root_gloss_range: skin, visible surface, direct contact, good news, and rejoicing; here narrowed to favorable heralding with visible reception pressure
words.prose: {{ar:بَشِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:bashīran}}) is an accusative role-state of the sent addressee, not a separate object or later activity. The mission installs the messenger as bearer of favorable notice before the warning term completes the pair. The {{ar:ب ش ر}} ({{tr:b-sh-r}}) field is narrowed to heralding, while its surface-and-joy imagery keeps the announcement receiver-facing: the news is meant to alter the hearer's horizon. Its durable role form and its pairing with the warning role make good news one half of a balanced commission, the same herald-warner mission pairing seen at 2:119 but here widened to all people.

topics.headline: herald role of the sent addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees good news as part of the commissioned role-state, not a later optional activity.
topics.reason: The accusative role noun predicates a function of the object suffix under the sending verb.

topics.headline: visible glad-news reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the visible-response pressure of the root while local role position selects heralding good news.
topics.reason: Skin/contact branches are background; the mission-role context selects favorable heralding.

topics.headline: durable herald identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the messenger defined by a stable herald role rather than a one-time act.
topics.reason: The role noun pattern gives a durable quality in an accusative state.

topics.headline: first half of balanced mission pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees favorable notice begin the role pair while warning remains its coordinated counterpart.
topics.reason: Critical rows connect this role with the herald-warning formula, its order, and its pairing with the following warning noun.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector joining the warning role to the herald role
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second role to the first without making warning an afterthought. The fused entry into the warning noun means the warning role arrives already coordinated with the herald role. The particle turns two matching accusatives into one balanced role-pair, so favorable notice and warning accompany one another inside the same mission.

topics.headline: warning joined without hierarchy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning added as a simultaneous counterpart to good news, not a correction or afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second role noun with the first inside the same role frame.

topics.headline: surface hinge between matching roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the connector making two formally similar role nouns read as one balanced pair.
topics.reason: The particle is prefixed to the warning noun and mediates the local echo between matching accusatives.

words.gloss_range: accusative warning role coordinated with the herald role
words.root_gloss_range: warning, advance notice of feared consequence, vow, and binding future speech; here narrowed to warning-envoy identity
words.prose: {{ar:نَذِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:nadhīran}}) completes the role pair as an equal accusative state under the sending verb. The {{ar:ن ذ ر}} ({{tr:n-dh-r}}) family includes vow and binding speech, but the local role noun under commission selects advance warning: notice before consequence, not alarm after the fact. Its form gives warning an enduring mission identity, and its placement just before the adversative clause establishes the full consequence-spectrum that most people fail to recognize. The every-community warner logic of 35:24 is intensified here by comprehensive human scope, while same-surah warning scenes at 34:34 and 34:44 keep warning and refusal in view.

topics.headline: warning as equal role-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning as equally built into the restricted sending, not as a subordinate consequence after rejection.
topics.reason: The noun shares the accusative role frame and coordination with the herald role.

topics.headline: advance notice tied to consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears warning as accountable advance notice before consequence, while vow senses remain only background pressure.
topics.reason: The n-dh-r family includes vow language, but the sent role noun locally selects warning-envoy sense.

topics.headline: enduring warning identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning as a standing mission identity, not a single warning act.
topics.reason: The qualitative role noun differs from a finite act or active participle and matches the paired role form.

topics.headline: second half of consequence spectrum
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pair complete a consequence-spectrum that makes reception responsible.
topics.reason: Rows connect the warning role with every-community warning logic, same-surah warning recurrence, and its position after the herald role.

words.gloss_range: connector that attaches the adversative reception clause to the mission statement
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents a hard break after the role pair. It carries the reader from mission definition into audience assessment, so the next clause does not cancel the sending but measures reception against it. The discourse focus shifts from the singular commissioned messenger to the third-person majority audience, and the fused move into the adversative particle makes continuity and contrast arrive together.

topics.headline: connected turn to reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reception problem attached to the mission statement rather than introduced as a separate topic.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the adversative clause while preserving continuity with the preceding role pair.

topics.headline: from commission to audience evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the discourse shift from the singular commissioned messenger to the third-person majority audience.
topics.reason: Critical rows identify a move from second-person object address to third-person audience assessment.

topics.headline: continuity and correction fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the written unit carrying connection and contrast in one move.
topics.reason: The connector is prefixed to the adversative particle.

words.gloss_range: adversative inna-class particle governing the majority clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَٰكِنَّ}} ({{tr:lākinna}}) installs the contrast grammatically: it governs the majority term as its noun and takes the negated knowledge predicate as its judgment. The particle preserves the universal mission while relocating the problem to uptake by the audience. Its long vowel and doubled nūn make the pivot weighty, and the majority wording keeps the failure dominant without making it total.

topics.headline: contrast grammatically installed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the majority and non-knowledge predicate governed as a formal contrast clause.
topics.reason: The particle behaves as an inna-class adversative with an accusative noun and predicate.

topics.headline: mission preserved, uptake qualified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the contrast does not weaken universal sending; it locates failure in majority recognition.
topics.reason: The adversative particle qualifies the human side of reception while the prior mission assertion remains intact.

topics.headline: marked adversative sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the turn as a marked pivot from mission roles to audience diagnosis.
topics.reason: Rows connect the particle's acoustic weight and position with the ayah's third movement.

words.gloss_range: construct elative measuring the larger share of the human public
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, increase, multiplicity, rivalry in increase, and comparative greatness; here narrowed to partitive majority
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرَ}} ({{tr:akthara}}) measures, rather than merely amplifies. As a construct elative under the adversative particle, it selects the larger share from the following people noun and makes non-knowledge a population-level diagnosis. The {{ar:ك ث ر}} ({{tr:k-th-r}}) abundance field is narrowed to majority, preserving a knowing minority while setting the earlier totality term against a dominant failure: total address, most people unaware. The majority formula also resonates beyond this line: 12:103 uses most-people language for non-belief, and 34:36 repeats the majority non-knowledge diagnosis inside Saba.

topics.headline: partitive majority, not vague abundance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a measured larger share of the human public, not an undefined crowd.
topics.reason: The elative is accusative under the adversative particle and construct with the people noun.

topics.headline: abundance narrowed to majority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps quantitative pressure from the root while local form limits it to comparative majority.
topics.reason: The broader abundance field is narrowed by the elative construct form.

topics.headline: total address versus majority failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's central irony: the mission reaches all, but non-knowledge dominates the addressed public.
topics.reason: Critical rows pair the totality word with the majority expression as opposing scale terms.

topics.headline: majority non-knowledge motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places the phrase inside a familiar and same-surah pattern of public non-recognition.
topics.reason: Rows cite 12:103 and same-surah recurrence around 34:35-36 and 34:41.

words.gloss_range: second people noun as genitive complement of the majority expression
words.root_gloss_range: human sociality, familiarity, perception, and contested forgetfulness pressure; here narrowed to the assessed public from which the majority is counted
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) repeats the same human public but under a new governor. No new group appears: the first occurrence was recipient field, while this one is the whole from which the majority is counted. The {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) social and perception pressure is narrowed by the construct frame, yet it sharpens the irony that the recognizable human public stands immediately before a non-knowledge predicate. The phrase also participates in the majority non-knowledge formula shared with 12:21 and repeated within Saba at 34:36.

topics.headline: people as majority source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second people noun as the whole from which the non-knowing majority is counted.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive complement of the majority construct and supplies the referent for the plural predicate.

topics.headline: recognizable public under non-knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the irony that the socially recognizable human public is diagnosed as failing to know.
topics.reason: The root-image remains background pressure while the local construct selects the assessed population sense.

topics.headline: same public, changed relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the contrast remain internal to one repeated public: recipient first, measured majority now.
topics.reason: The noun repeats in definite collective form but changes governor from preposition to majority construct.

topics.headline: majority non-knowledge formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closing diagnosis as formulaic and as a same-surah refrain of public misrecognition.
topics.reason: Rows cite the exact formula at 12:21 and the same-surah recurrence at 34:36.

words.gloss_range: negator scoped over the final imperfect knowledge predicate
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the final knowledge verb, not the earlier sending. Its scope preserves the universal commission and names the contrast as absence of knowledge. Because the verb has no explicit object, the negation points backward to the whole mission profile as what is not recognized, while the brief sound delay before the final knowledge verb lets absence frame the closing predicate.

topics.headline: negation targets knowledge only
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah deny majority knowledge while preserving the universal commission already asserted.
topics.reason: The negator governs the imperfect knowledge verb inside the adversative predicate.

topics.headline: unstated object points backward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader lets the whole preceding mission profile supply what most people do not know.
topics.reason: The negated predicate closes the adversative clause while the following knowledge verb has no explicit object.

topics.headline: separate negation before closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears absence placed before and around the final knowledge verb.
topics.reason: The particle is independent before the imperfect verb and its long vowel creates a brief recited suspension.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural knowledge verb with no explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, marking, signs, landmarks, teaching, and informing; here narrowed to collective recognition or non-recognition
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) closes the ayah with an ongoing collective state. Its plural form returns to the majority phrase, and its missing object leaves the prior mission profile as the content most people fail to grasp. The {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) field of marks and knowing is narrowed to reception-side recognition: the problem is not that no notice was sent, but that the mission's signifying scope and paired roles are not registered. The ending also completes a familiar non-knowledge formula shared with 12:21 and echoed again at 34:36. It bookends the ayah's opening negation and closes on a plural nasal sound, making public non-recognition the heard endpoint.

topics.headline: continuing collective non-knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees non-knowledge as an ongoing condition of the majority, not a completed past event or a defect in the messenger.
topics.reason: The imperfect third masculine plural predicate is controlled by the majority phrase.

topics.headline: open verb points back to mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader supplies the restricted mission profile as the unspoken content of failed knowledge.
topics.reason: The verb frame has no explicit direct object, so the prior clause remains the recoverable object field.

topics.headline: knowledge as recognition of signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failure as reception-side recognition, not lack of sent notice or teaching.
topics.reason: Teaching and informing derivatives are background, while the local Form I negated predicate diagnoses knowing or recognition.

topics.headline: non-knowledge refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closing phrase as a formulaic and same-surah diagnosis of public misrecognition.
topics.reason: Critical rows cite 12:21 and exact recurrence at 34:36.

topics.headline: negative and nasal closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close with negation and plural nasal sound after opening under negation.
topics.reason: Rows connect the opening and closing negations and identify the final plural sound pattern.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction kāffatan li-l-nās, reinforced by the second occurrence of al-nās.
baseline_models.mechanism: A carried message is dispatched into the human collective as an encompassing whole; its hopeful and alarming faces address the same unrestricted audience, while the majority clause marks failed uptake inside that total scope.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message branch supplies the carried communication and makes dispatch the mechanism's initiating act.
Encompassing everyone supplies the mission's unrestricted human perimeter.
The visible human collective supplies both the audience and the majority located within it.
Joy-opening news supplies the attractive face of the communication.
Danger-announcement that awakens caution supplies the communication's protective face.
Numerical predominance locates non-recognition in most, without narrowing the all-human address.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the uptake that the majority clause negates.

changed_reading.before: The verse appoints a messenger for a large audience.
changed_reading.after: The verse establishes an all-human communication perimeter and then diagnoses majority non-recognition inside, not outside, that perimeter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated role nouns bashīran wa-nadhīran followed by lā yaʿlamūn.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger carries two anticipatory signals: one opens the surface toward a hoped-for arrival and one sounds danger early enough to activate caution. Together they make otherwise future consequences knowable in advance.

activation_trace.role: The carried-message branch supplies the vehicle by which both signals travel.
First traces appearing before completion make good news an advance indicator rather than only a pleasant report.
An alarm that awakens caution supplies the adverse advance indicator.
A distinguishing mark that guides toward its referent makes the paired reports signs to be read.

changed_reading.before: Bashīr and nadhīr are two descriptive titles.
changed_reading.after: They are a paired advance-signal system intended to turn an unseen future into actionable present knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tension between arsalnāka, which releases or dispatches, and the k-f-f form kāffatan.
baseline_models.mechanism: A messenger is released into the human field to check movement toward harm: warning supplies the stop-signal, while good news supplies a positive direction rather than mere inhibition.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch supply the outward movement of the intervention.
Checking, preventing, and turning back supply the intervention's restraining function.
Warning activates caution and operationalizes restraint before danger.
Joy-opening news prevents the model from reducing the mission to prohibition alone.

changed_reading.before: Kāffatan states only how many people are addressed.
changed_reading.after: It may also color what the dispatched messenger does: restrain people from danger through a warning paired with an opening toward good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Bashīran and lā yaʿlamūn within an address to al-nās.
baseline_models.mechanism: The message gives concealed outcomes a publicly perceptible surface and distinguishing marks. The majority's deficit is therefore not simply missing data but failure to register what has been made socially and sensorially available.

activation_trace.role: The carried saying supplies the content placed in public circulation.
Seeing, sensing, or hearing supplies the audience's available mode of recognition.
The exposed skin or surface supplies a material analogy for truth becoming outwardly legible.
A visible distinguishing mark supplies the bridge from displayed sign to knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Most people merely lack abstract information.
changed_reading.after: A public signal has been surfaced for them, yet most fail to convert perception of its marks into recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kāffatan through the packet's secondary k-f-y mapping, in construction with li-l-nās.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split-root inventory permits kāffatan to activate adequacy: the dispatched communication stands up to the whole human need by supplying both promise and warning. This is form-distant and coexists with the direct k-f-f totality and restraint readings.

activation_trace.role: Carrying an affair until sufficiency is reached supplies the exploratory adequacy mechanism.
The carried message is the thing proposed as adequate for the addressed need.
The human collective defines the breadth of the need for which adequacy is proposed.
Good news supplies one necessary side of a complete communication.
Warning supplies the complementary protective side of that communication.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the mission is also adequate to the human condition because it carries both needed orientations, promise and warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context fills space with inward, outward, downward, and upward movement, then spans from the smallest to the largest. These axes thicken kāffatan from a population count into coverage with no privileged direction or scale.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing all supplies the focus anchor whose geometry is expanded by the context.
Entry into an interior supplies inward traversal of the covered field.
Passing outward supplies the inverse traversal and closes the in-out axis.
Descent and arrival supply downward movement through the field.
Ascent supplies the opposing upward movement.
Smallness supplies one endpoint of a scale that excludes no minute case.
Magnitude supplies the opposite endpoint and completes the scale.

structural_cues: 34:2 repeats four matched relative clauses for what enters, exits, descends, and ascends.
34:3 encloses smaller and larger items within the paired heavens-and-earth frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive directional and scalar pairs; I project their coverage geometry onto kāffatan. A live alternative is that these pairs describe divine knowledge only and do not specify the messenger's reach.

changed_reading.before: All people means an undifferentiated numerical total.
changed_reading.after: The all-human scope is imagined as coverage across moving interiors and exteriors, vertical directions, and scalar extremes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A chain of visible settlements and measured travel turns universal dispatch into a relay across inhabited nodes. The next ayah's requested distance and resulting fragmentation show what the relay must cross and repair: human totality is distributed, route-dependent, and liable to rupture.

activation_trace.role: Successive companies supply a relay image for dispatch reaching distributed groups.
All-encompassing scope requires the relay to include every inhabited node.
People gathered in settlements supply the human nodes of the relay.
Prominent visibility makes the intermediate nodes publicly findable.
Measured planning supplies ordered intervals rather than accidental contact.
Travel and flow activate movement along the linked settlement chain.
Producing distance supplies the deliberate rupture of accessible intervals.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the social geography the universal message must span.

structural_cues: 34:18 sequences visible settlements, measured travel, nights, days, and safety.
34:19 reverses that accessibility into requested distance, self-wrong, stories, and complete dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a connected route and its rupture; I infer that successive dispatch is a communicative relay across dispersed communities. The route may instead function only as a material history of provision and ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: A single center broadcasts one message to a global mass.
changed_reading.after: Universal sending works as a relay through inhabited nodes, retaining scope even when communities become distant and fragmented.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly places beneficial and harmful outcomes in parallel response tracks. This converts the two focus roles from tonal labels into a causal fork: the message announces what distinct patterns of reception grow into.

activation_trace.role: Joy-opening news names the beneficial arm of the fork.
Danger-announcement names the harmful arm early enough for caution.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the causal linkage between response and outcome.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer supplies one concrete good announced.
An apportioned gift supplies the positive consequence paired with protection.
Painful punishment supplies the concrete adverse consequence of the warning track.
Increase by a matching multiple intensifies the beneficial consequence in the later reprise.
The repeated punishment branch restores the adverse track immediately after the intensified reward.

structural_cues: 34:4-5 juxtaposes believers who act well with those who strive against the signs.
34:37-38 repeats the same beneficial-versus-punitive sequencing after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored recipient groups and outcomes; I assign the arrow from the focus's two heralding roles to those consequence tracks. The live alternative is that bashīr and nadhīr remain general titles without encoding this exact local pairing.

changed_reading.before: The messenger alternates reassurance and threat.
changed_reading.after: He announces a response-sensitive consequence fork, making both possible trajectories knowable before they mature.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge in the surah repeatedly arises when a visible disclosure is correctly matched to reality, while failure persists before clear signs and even after demonstrations. The focus's majority clause therefore diagnoses failed recognition of available evidence, not simple absence of exposure.

activation_trace.role: Advance traces supply signs that should permit recognition before completion.
A mark that distinguishes and guides supplies the focus's evidentiary model of knowing.
Vision by eye or insight supplies the act by which informed recipients recognize revelation.
Knowledge as disclosure identifies the recipients capable of the recognition.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what correct seeing recognizes.
Emergence into clarity supplies the collapse-triggered disclosure of prior ignorance.
The counterfactual knowing of the unseen marks the knowledge disproved by visible events.
The repeated numerical majority ties the focus diagnosis to a second concrete domain.
The repeated human audience confirms that the same collective remains under diagnosis.
The exact repeated non-knowing clause applies failed recognition to provision's expansion and restriction.
Meaning made clear by signs and speech supplies evidence that is present yet reclassified as deception.

structural_cues: 34:6 joins people given knowledge, seeing, revelation, and truth in one recognition chain.
34:14 makes a collapse reveal that the workers had not known the unseen.
34:36 repeats most people do not know almost verbatim.
34:43 answers clear recited signs with inherited resistance and accusations of fabrication and magic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, correct recognition, demonstrable ignorance, an exact refrain, and rejection of clarity; I infer that the focus names a recognition failure. A live alternative is a narrower lack of doctrinal knowledge rather than resistant misclassification.

changed_reading.before: Most people have not received enough information.
changed_reading.after: Most people fail to let publicly available marks disclose what they indicate, even though universal sending has already supplied exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes coercive power from channels of following, diversion, and repeated command. Against that social machinery, the k-f-f restraint activation becomes counter-interception: the messenger checks inherited or organized movement away from guidance without wielding compulsion.

activation_trace.role: Prevention and turning back supply the focus's counter-diversion function.
Warning activates caution rather than force and defines how the checking works.
Following in another's wake supplies the social current that carries most recipients.
Overpowering force is explicitly named and denied, constraining restraint to non-coercive intervention.
Turning and diverting supply the disputed blockage between guidance and socially weaker recipients.
Demand and imposition supply the repeated directive pressure attributed to dominant recipients.
The accusation that the messenger diverts people from ancestral worship mirrors and reverses the blockage claim.

structural_cues: 34:20-21 places widespread following beside the denial of coercive authority.
34:31-33 stages reciprocal blame between the socially weakened and the self-exalting.
34:43 frames the messenger himself as an alleged diverter from inherited worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following without coercive authority and rival claims about who diverted whom; I infer that k-f-f restraint intercepts those channels through warning. The direct alternative remains that kāffatan means only all people and carries no restraining predication.

changed_reading.before: The messenger restrains isolated individuals from discrete bad acts.
changed_reading.after: The mission checks socially transmitted diversion, creating room for recognition without replacing one coercive authority with another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same dispatch root releases both a human messenger and, elsewhere, a dam-flood, while later ayat repeatedly bind sending to warning. The shared mechanism is not identity of messenger and flood but release into a field where the dispatched thing has effects.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch supply the focus's outward operative movement.
Warning defines the messenger's effect as awakened caution before danger arrives.
The repeated release verb supplies a material counter-instance of dispatch producing consequences.
Flood-flow supplies the force actually released in the contextual instance.
A retaining dam supplies the boundary whose failure turns held force into released flow.
Repeated messenger dispatch joins sender, warning-bearer, and resistant recipients in one transmission event.
The warning role is explicitly attached to the repeated dispatch pattern.
The claimed absence of an earlier dispatch marks the present sending as a new effective arrival.
The absent prior figure is specifically a danger-announcer, confirming dispatch's preventive aim.

structural_cues: 34:16 uses the focus's dispatch root for the flood released after turning away.
34:34 repeats sending and warning in a generalized town pattern.
34:44 stresses that no warning-bearer had previously been sent to these recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence across messenger and flood plus repeated sent-warner constructions; I infer a shared release-to-effect dynamic. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no material analogy between the dispatched entities.

changed_reading.before: Sending is an administrative appointment that precedes speech.
changed_reading.after: Sending releases an effective signal into history: unlike the flood, its immediate force is to make caution possible before consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The all-human audience is operationally decomposed into pairs and solitary persons who stand and think. Universality therefore does not require mass conformity; the same warning reaches everyone through deliberative units small enough to interrupt group pressure.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing everyone supplies the aggregate that the context decomposes.
The human collective supplies the social scale from which pairs and individuals are drawn.
Fear-awakening reminder supplies the focused intervention delivered to the decomposed audience.
One in number supplies the single proposition around which deliberation is organized.
Rising with resolve supplies the audience's active break from passive crowd membership.
Joining one to one supplies the paired deliberative unit.
The isolated one supplies the irreducible individual unit.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the process by which each unit tests the message.
The repeated warning role reconnects this small-unit exercise directly to the focus mission.

structural_cues: 34:46 moves in sequence from one exhortation to standing, pairs, solitary persons, reflection, the familiar companion, and warning.
The pair-and-individual instruction comes after prolonged scenes of followers, leaders, and inherited claims.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal scope and an explicit pair-or-single reflection procedure; I infer that the latter is how the former reaches persons without crowd mediation. A live alternative is that 34:46 offers only a local method for evaluating the messenger.

changed_reading.before: All humanity is addressed chiefly as one mass audience.
changed_reading.after: Universal scope preserves individual agency by reaching the mass through pairs and solitary reflection rather than requiring collective uptake.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed appointment, warning positioned before punishment, and the closing sequence from nearness to failed far-reaching and final barrier turn the paired heralding roles into a temporal access window. The message reaches people now because later recognition can arrive after reach has become impossible.

activation_trace.role: First traces of what is coming supply the early side of the access window.
Advance danger-notice supplies the warning while response remains possible.
An appointment bounded by time supplies the fixed terminus of the window.
Advance and precedence, here negated, prevent recipients from moving the terminus forward.
The repeated warning makes caution the intended use of the still-open interval.
Placement before one's hands spatializes the messenger on the near side of punishment.
Failure to escape or attain supplies the first explicit closure of reach.
Nearness makes capture immediate despite the earlier illusion of distance.
Extending to take hold supplies the late attempt at retrieval.
Distance defeats that late reach and contrasts with the message's earlier proximity.
A separating barrier supplies the terminal state in which desired response can no longer cross.

structural_cues: 34:29-30 asks when the promise comes and answers with an appointment that cannot be delayed or advanced.
34:46 places the warner before a severe punishment.
34:51-54 progresses through no escape, seizure from near, impossible reach from far, and a final barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed timing and a staged loss of reach; I infer that the focus's heralding functions create a present response interval. The live alternative is that the closing sequence concerns only punishment after disbelief and does not define the earlier mission's temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Good news and warning report an unspecified future.
changed_reading.after: They make the present a reachable decision interval before a fixed future closes the distance between recognition and effective response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing declarations model transmission as hidden knowledge cast outward, truth arriving, falsehood losing productive motion, and revelation becoming hearable at close range. The focus messenger is thus a vector that converts concealed knowledge into public, discriminating signal.

activation_trace.role: The carried communication supplies the human transmission vehicle.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the intended endpoint of transmission.
Casting outward supplies the forceful launch of truth into the public field.
Reality-stable truth supplies the content launched.
Initiating motion, here denied to falsehood, supplies one side of the transmission asymmetry.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the signal that cannot sustain productive transmission.
Neither initiating nor repeating supplies falsehood's silenced return channel.
Knowledge delivered in concealment supplies the hidden origin of the messenger's guidance.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the receiver-side completion of the channel.
Nearness shortens the channel and removes distance as an excuse for failed reception.

structural_cues: 34:48 moves from spoken command to casting truth by one who knows hidden things.
34:49 announces truth's arrival and denies falsehood both initiation and repetition.
34:50 locates guidance in revelation and closes with hearing and nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies launch, arrival, productive asymmetry, hidden revelation, hearing, and nearness; I connect them into a transmission path fulfilled by the focus messenger. They may instead be adjacent assertions without a single communication mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The messenger repeats information already available in propositional form.
changed_reading.after: He is the public leg of a hidden-to-near transmission vector that launches truth into human hearing and distinguishes it from nonproductive falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split k-f-y adequacy activation gains force when claimed powers are stripped of ownership, partnership, independent intercession, benefit, and harm. The all-human message appears sufficient not by monopolizing force but by remaining a viable guidance channel when imagined supports fail.

activation_trace.role: Carrying an affair to sufficiency supplies the exploratory focus mechanism.
Ownership and capacity to dispose, here denied, remove one proposed rival support.
A helper joining another, here made permission-dependent, removes autonomous mediation.
Benefit opposed to harm, here denied to intercession by itself, tests practical adequacy.
Denied mutual control shows the eventual collapse of person-to-person possession of outcomes.
Denied mutual benefit strips one final substitute for receiving the warning.
Denied mutual harm completes the context's removal of independent human outcome-control.

structural_cues: 34:22 denies invoked powers any atom of ownership, share, or supporting role.
34:23 makes intercession effective only by permission.
34:42 denies people mutual control of benefit and harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the secondary k-f-y inventory and progressive removal of rival agencies; I infer that the message's twofold orientation is adequate when those supports collapse. The live and stronger alternatives derive kāffatan directly from k-f-f as all-encompassing or restraining.

changed_reading.before: The split-root sufficiency image is an isolated lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a coherent, though still form-distant, reading in which the universal mission remains an adequate guidance channel after rival supports prove unable to own outcomes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the materially distant k-f-f image of a containing scale-pan. It remains anchored in kāffatan and is strengthened by contextual gathering and adjudication of all; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-material analogy, not as a grammatical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kāffatan at word 4, especially the containing-pan and all-encompassing branches.

activation_trace.role: A pan or containing vessel supplies the outlier's bounded common field.
Encompassing everyone places the whole human audience within that field.
Drawing dispersed parties into one aggregate supplies the common gathering.
Opening what is closed by judgment supplies adjudication within the gathered field.
Driving and gathering a multitude toward one destination gives the analogy its eschatological horizon.
Completion without dispersion or deficit supplies the all-together state.

changed_reading.before: Kāffatan only expands the present audience outward.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also anticipates humanity enclosed within one common field of gathering and truthful adjudication.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the sociable familiarity branches of n-w-s and r-s-l rather than the dominant population and dispatch senses. It remains anchored in the repeated al-nās and arsalnāka, while the messenger is later called their companion and hearing is paired with nearness; downstream prose should qualify it as a relational activation, not a claim that universal scope literally means intimacy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Arsalnāka and both occurrences of al-nās, read through familiarity rather than anonymous mass.

activation_trace.role: Ease, familiarity, and unguarded presence supply a relational mode for the dispatch.
Companionship that removes estrangement recasts the human collective as potentially familiar rather than anonymous.
Explicit companionship and sustained association place the warning-bearer within the audience's known social field.
Audible reception supplies immediate interpersonal access to the message.
Nearness supplies the relation that can overcome estrangement even within an all-human address.

changed_reading.before: Universality requires impersonal broadcast to anonymous humanity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the all-human mission scales through familiar presence: a known companion makes a near, hearable address without surrendering universal scope.

strongest_changes: Kāffatan became multidimensional coverage across direction, scale, settlement networks, and dispersed communities rather than a bare population total.
Bashīr and nadhīr became paired advance signals tied to mirrored consequence tracks and to a response window that eventually closes.
Most people do not know became a diagnosis of failed sign-recognition despite public exposure, not merely missing information.
The restraint branch became socially functional: warning intercepts following and diversion without coercive authority.
The all-human collective was decomposed into pairs and solitary persons, preserving reflective agency within universal scope.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly translated the focus's compact universal claim into mechanisms of movement, relay, social pressure, visible disclosure, fixed timing, and eventual gathering while keeping several incompatible k-f-f branches alive.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether kāffatan syntactically supports an active restraining role or only all-encompassing scope remains unresolved.
The k-f-y sufficiency model is packet-licensed but form-distant and should remain subordinate to direct k-f-f readings.
The motion, flood-dispatch, and gathering-pan models may be productive analogies without being intended lexical specifications of 34:28.
Failed knowing can still be parsed as cognitive deficit, resistant misclassification, or both.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Universality gathers an oscillating public between two anticipatory signals.** `ر س ل/B001` is being sent forth, `ك ف ف/B006` total inclusion, `ن و س/B001` swaying oscillation, `ب ش ر/B007` first visible signs, and `ن ذ ر/B001` warning that awakens caution. Sending extends the message, total inclusion closes the boundary around all people, and good tidings/warning supply opposed signals to a swaying audience. The packet gives scope and paired roles; I infer that the pair stabilizes movement by showing both desired and dangerous futures. The ayah reads universality as comprehensive orientation of an unstable human field, while widespread non-knowledge explains incomplete uptake.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:46 supplied paired and solitary reflection as an uptake method, while 34:47 removed payment as a competing motive for the universal warning.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A mission that both includes and restrains all.** `ك ف ف B006` supplies total inclusion, while `ك ف ف B002` supplies withholding and restraining. The mission is `لِلنَّاسِ`, and warning precedes the fixed appointment of 34:29-30; 34:31-33 then shows class divisions trying to transfer responsibility. The two branches assign `كَآفَّةً` universal scope and a braking function. The packet supplies audience, warning, and downstream evasion; I infer that universality is also universal restraint before consequence. The mission reads as an all-person warning field, not reach alone.

2. **Tidings and warning as advance signals.** `ب ش ر B007` supplies first visible signs or forerunners, and `ن ذ ر B001` a warning that awakens caution. Their pairing before the question about the promise makes both anticipatory. The packet supplies the two roles and later deadline; I infer that they expose different possible outcomes before arrival. The messenger reads as making the future actionable in the present.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:31-33 showed why `كَآفَّةً` must cross class divisions: dominant and weakened groups both try to move responsibility elsewhere. Universal address prevents either stratum from outsourcing response to the other.

baseline.text: Biz seni bütün insanlara yalnızca müjdeci ve uyarıcı olarak gönderdik. Fakat insanların çoğu bilmez.

findings.text: Evrensel gönderiliş, salınan insan topluluğunu iki öncü işaretle yönlendirir: müjde istenen geleceği, uyarı tehlikeli geleceği şimdiden görünür kılar.
Bütün insanları kapsama, yalnız erişim genişliği değil, sonuç gelmeden önce herkesi yanlış hareketten alıkoyan ortak bir sınır işlevi de taşır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3: Dispatch Meets Socially Stratified Reception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A warning mission is broadly dispatched, but reception is filtered by ignorance and by the interests of affluent settlement elites.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same `ب ش ر` surface that carries glad tidings also activates the human creature, joining universal audience and messenger function within one lexical hinge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Human-Wide Paired Dispatch
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A commissioned sending encompasses the people through paired good-news and warning functions despite widespread nonrecognition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: commissioned sending (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`), total encompassment (`quranic:root_001308:B006/m01`), human creature (`quranic:root_000120:B002/m01`), glad tidings (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`), danger announcement (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`), knowing versus ignorance (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Universality is not only numerical. The human sense latent in `بَشِيرًا` makes the message's mode answer to the kind of being addressed, while warning and good news preserve its two possible receptions.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kolay ve zorlamasız ilerleyişi; yumuşak eklem ve bacakları; düz, salık saçı aynı akıcılık niteliği çevresinde toplar. Çerçeve, yürüyüşü tek başına bütün dal saymadan bu ortak niteliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, harekette ve uzanışta yumuşak akıcılığı kapsar; gönderme, süt ve ardışık topluluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hareketin zorlamasız, rahat ve akıcı olması ya da bir uzvun veya saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan yumuşakça uzanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ortak nitelik, direnç ve sertlik göstermeyen rahat bir akış veya uzanıştır.
Yürüyüşte bu nitelik, hayvanı zorlamayan kolay ve akıcı ilerleyiş olarak görünür.
Bacaklar ve eklemler için yumuşaklık, saç için düz ve salık uzanma anlatılır.
Deve topluluğuna uygulandığında hızlı ya da kolayca harekete geçen sürüler kastedilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kolay yürüyüş, yumuşak eklem ve bacaklar, salık saç ve rahatça ilerleyen deve topluluklarını dirençsiz akıcılık çevresinde birleştirir.

error_profile.preserves: Kolay ilerleme ile sert olmayan, salık uzanma arasındaki ortak niteliği korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iş, konuşma ve okumada aceleyi bırakıp sakin, ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemeyi ortak çekirdek yapar. Çerçevedeki yavaşlık, ağırbaşlılık ve dikkat bu çekirdeğin birbirini tamamlayan yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, acele etmeden ölçülü davranma ve okumayı kapsar; ardışık topluluk veya taşınan ileti anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel temkin niteliği korunur; yavaş ol buyruğu, iş ve konuşmadaki tutum ile okumadaki açık söyleyiş kendi kullanım sınırlarında ayrılır.

Okumada metni acele etmeden açık, belirgin ve dikkatli söyleme kastedilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin iç dünyasının birine veya bir şeye yönelmesini; yabancılık duygusunun kalkıp güven, rahatlık ve açıklık doğmasını anlatır. Çerçeve bu iç yöneliş ile dışa açılma sonucunu doğru bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, birine veya bir şeye ısınıp yanında rahatça açılmayı kapsar; yavaş okuma veya genel gönderme anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, birine ya da bir şeye yönelmeyi belirten yapılarla sınırlıdır; yalın köke genel bir yakınlık anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye veya şeye içten yönelip yabancılık duymamak; ona güvenerek yanında rahatlamak ve kendini çekinmeden açmaktır.

facets.statement: Kişinin iç yönelişi, yabancılıktan yakınlık ve güvene geçiş oluşturur.
Bu güvenin görünür sonucu, karşısındakinin yanında rahat ve açık davranmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin birine veya bir şeye içten yönelmesini; onun yanında güven, yakınlık, rahatlık ve açıklık kazanmasını ortak biçimde anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İç yöneliş, güven ve rahat dışa açılma aşamalarını birlikte taşıyan kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakınlık duyma, güvenme ve rahatça açılma bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İlk yabancılık duygusunun kalkıp yakınlık doğduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İçten yönelme ve yakınlık kazanma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yerleşmiş güven ve çekinmeden açılma sonucunu tam belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin karşısındakinin yanında çekinmeden konuşup davranması anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güven ve rahat dışa açılma sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeye yönelik ilk iç çekimi ayrıca göstermez.

sana güvenip yanında rahat davranan kimse

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sohbetten duyulan sevinci, yakınlık sağlayan varlığı ve insana alışkın hayvanı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi yabancılık ve yalnızlık duygusunun yakınlıkla kalkmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yönelme ve açılma sürecidir; komşu yakınlığın kişisini, nesnesini ve sonucunu daha geniş adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, güven ve yakınlık duygusundan doğan rahatlığı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, konuşkanlık, güler yüz ve toplumsal çekingenliği bırakma gibi dış davranışları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin başkalarının yanında rahat ve açık görünmesine yol açabilir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الاسترسال إلى الإنسان أو الشيء بمعنى الأنس والطمأنينة والانبساط
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الترسل في القراءة ولا إرسال الرسالة
branches.source_phrase_ar: استرسلت إلى الشيء إذا انبعثت نفسك إليه وأنست (maqayis)؛ الاسترسال إلى شيء كالاستئناس والطمأنينة (ayn)؛ استرسل إليه أي انبسط واستأنس (sihah)؛ الاسترسال إلى الإنسان كالاستئناس والطمأنينة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karşılıklı haberleşmeyi, atışma gibi bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte öncekinin ardından gitmeyi aynı karşılıklılık ve izleme alanında toplar. Çerçeve bu özel katılımcı rollerini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, karşılıklı iletişim ve ortak uğraşta eşlik edip izlemeyi kapsar; tek yönlü gönderiyi veya yalnızca taşınan iletiyi kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım karşılıklı haberleşme, yarışma eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte izleme biçimlerini kendi yapılara bağlı tutar; yalın köke genel arkadaşlık anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: İki kişinin karşılıklı haberleşmesi veya ortak bir uğraşta birbirine ayak uydurması; özellikle atışma gibi bir işte yanında durması ya da şarkı ve çalışmada öncekinin ardından gitmesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki taraf arasında karşılıklı gönderim veya birinin ötekini izlemesiyle kurulan eşgüdümdür.
Atışma veya başka bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran ve onunla birlikte ilerleyen eşlikçi kastedilebilir.
Şarkı veya işte bir öncekinin sesini ya da eylemini izleyerek sürdüren kişi kastedilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı haberleşme, ortak uğraşta yan yana durma ve şarkı ya da işte bir öncekinin ardından gitme biçimlerini eşgüdümlü eşlik alanında verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber alışverişi ile ortak uğraşta yan yana veya art arda ilerleme biçimlerini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklılık, eşgüdüm ve izleyerek eşlik etme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki taraf birbirine ileti gönderdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı gönderim ve iletişim yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Atışma, şarkı veya işteki fiziksel ve sıralı eşliği kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir uğraşta, şarkıda veya işte başkasını izleyen kişi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ortak uğraşta ayak uydurma ve izleme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Karşılıklı ileti gönderme anlamını göstermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, eşi ölmüş veya kendisinden ayrılmış kadını ve ayrılığın yaklaştığını sezen kadını, taliplerin kendisine evlenme önerisi iletmesi bakımından birleştirir. Çerçeve hem gerçekleşmiş hem beklenen ayrılık koşulunu açıkça korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız bu kadın durumuna ve taliplerin ileti kurmasına bağlıdır; genel haberleşmeyi veya bütün dul kadınları koşulsuz biçimde kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız verilen kadın nitelemesine bağlıdır; genel haberleşme veya genel evlilik durumu anlamı olarak yalınlaştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Eşi ölmüş, boşanmış ya da eşinin kendisini boşayacağını sezmiş olduğu için taliplerin kendisine evlenme önerileri ilettiği kadındır.

facets.statement: Kadın, mevcut veya yaklaşan eş kaybı nedeniyle yeni taliplerin ileti kurabildiği kişi olarak nitelenir.
Koşul, eşin ölmesi veya boşanmanın gerçekleşmesi olabileceği gibi boşanma niyetinin kadınca sezilmesi de olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, önceki evlilik bağının sona ermesi veya sona ereceğinin sezilmesi üzerine taliplerin kendisine evlenme önerileri gönderdiği kadını anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: taliplerin haber gönderdiği dul veya ayrılmak üzere olan kadın
concept_gloss.applicability: Gerçekleşmiş eş kaybı ile beklenen boşanmayı ve taliplerin ileti kurmasını birlikte taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadının evlilik durumunu, olası ayrılık aşamasını ve yeni taliplerin ileti kurmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Terimin özel evlilik ve ileti koşulunu okura açıklamak gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Taliplerin kadınla yeni evlilik amacıyla ileti kurmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Önceki eşin ölmesi, boşanma veya beklenen boşanma koşullarını tek başına belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: eşi ölmüş, boşanmış veya ayrılmak üzere olduğu için taliplerin haber gönderdiği kadın

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kullanımda sıkıntının karşıtı olan rahatlığı, başka bir kullanımda ise bir şeyi içten ve isteyerek vermeyi gösterir. Çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak gönüllü veriş rahatlık çekirdeğinin bağımsız eş anlamlısı değil, belirli verme bağlamındaki uzantısı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen yapılarda rahatlık ve gönül hoşluğuyla vermeyi kapsar; genel süt, sürü veya bütün refah adlandırmalarına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız sıkıntı-rahatlık karşıtlığını ve gönül hoşluğuyla verme kullanımını taşıyan belirtilmiş yapıya bağlıdır; yalın bir kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz yapılarında sıkıntı ve sertliğin karşıtı olan rahatlık ile bir şeyi zorlanmadan, gönül hoşluğuyla verme durumunu anlatır.

facets.statement: Temel karşıtlık, sıkıntılı ve sert durum karşısındaki rahatlık ve ferahlıktır.
Verme bağlamında rahatlık, isteksizlik veya zorlama olmadan gönülden vermek olarak gerçekleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak malzemesi rahatlığı sıkıntının karşısına koyar; verme bağlamında bu rahatlık, kişinin içinden gelerek ve isteyerek vermesi biçiminde açıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Verilen yapıdaki durum karşıtlığını ve verme bağlamındaki özel uzantıyı birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Sıkıntının karşıtı rahatlığı ve isteyerek verme uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıkıntılı dönem ile rahat dönem karşı karşıya getirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Verişte isteklilik ve iç rahatlığını korur.
error_profile.loses: Sıkıntının karşıtı genel rahatlık durumunu kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sıkıntısında ve rahatlığında; gönül hoşluğuyla verirken

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal ortak bir anlam çekirdeği göstermeyen altı ayrı adlandırmayı bir arada tutmaktadır; kısa ok, iki damar, damızlık erkek deve, aktarım zinciri kopuk söz, boncuklu kolye ve başını örtmeyen küçük kız ayrı ayrı ele alınmalıdır.

facets.statement: Dalın tek ortak özelliği, ortak anlamı bulunmayan özel adlandırmaların geçici olarak aynı yapısal kapta toplanmış olmasıdır.
Bir kullanım birlikte anılan iki damarı adlandırır.
Bir kullanım belirli bir topluluğun damızlık erkek devesini adlandırır.
Bir kullanım aktarım zinciri kesintili olan bir sözü niteler.
Bir kullanım boncuk ve başka parçalardan oluşan kolyeyi adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan elinin avuç ve parmaklarla birlikte kavrayıp açılan bölümünü temel alır; kuşun tuttuğunu kavradığı organı da buna bağlı bir kullanım olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdek ile kuşa özgü uzantıyı doğru biçimde ayırmaktadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem kişinin bir işten geri durmasını hem de başkasını bir işten alıkoyup geri çevirmesini açıkça içerir. Yinelemeli biçim aynı geri çevirme işlemini güçlendirir; gözyaşını tutma ise bu çekirdeğin belirli bir nesneyle kurulan kullanımıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Özne kendi davranışını kesebilir ya da başka bir katılımcıyı ve bir şeyi ilerlemekten alıkoyabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın geri durma ile nesne veya kişi alan söz dizimlerini ve gözyaşı söz öbeğini birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir eylemi sürdürmeyip ondan geri durmak veya bir kişiyi ya da şeyi ilerlediği yönden alıkoyup geri çevirmektir. Aynı işlem gözyaşını akmaktan tutma gibi belirli bağlamlarda da gerçekleşir.

facets.statement: Kişi bir işi yapmaktan kendi isteğiyle ya da bir engel sonucu geri durur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar geri durma, başkasını engelleme ve bir şeyi geri çevirme anlamlarını ortak bir durdurma çekirdeğinde birleştirir; gözyaşını tutma bunun özel uygulamasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Öznenin kendini durdurduğu ve başka bir katılımcıyı engellediği kullanımları birlikte karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesindeki toplama, çevresini sarma, bağlayıp kapatma ve içindekinin üzerine kapatma örnekleri ortak bir çevreleme ve tutma işlemi oluşturur. Közün odunlarla çevrilmesi ve kötülüğün kapalı tutulması da bu işlemin uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey toplanır ya da çevresi sarılarak kuşatılır ve tutulur.
